channel.title: Dispatches from Gaza by The Blue Fern Co.
channel.description: Text-first Gaza audio briefing transcripts derived from source-backed daily editions.
channel.itunes:author: The Blue Fern Co.
channel.itunes:summary: Text-first Gaza audio briefing transcripts derived from source-backed daily editions.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 15, 2026
item.description: Palestinian death toll in Gaza tops 73,000, officials say, as Israel strikes despite ceasefire. Israel says it is targeting Hamas and other militants who pose a threat, and in response to ceasefire violations, including occasional attacks. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 14, 2026
item.description: Two killed in Israeli strike on Gaza. An Israeli strike on southern Gaza has killed two people and injured another, according to Palestinian authorities. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 13, 2026
item.description: Israeli army kills Palestinian municipality worker in central Gaza. Despite truce in effect since October 2025, Israeli army launches drone strike near Bureij refugee camp. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 12, 2026
item.description: Israel wounds 5 in shelling of Gaza school sheltering displaced Palestinians. Israeli army continues shelling and demolishing homes in eastern Gaza despite ceasefire. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 11, 2026
item.description: Amnesty accuses Israel's government of 'ethnic cleansing' of West Bank Palestinians. The London-based rights group says the Israeli government is deliberately trying to annex the Palestinian territory. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 10, 2026
item.description: Palestinians face systematic abuse by Israeli settlers and Hamas alike: Independent investigators. Palestinian civilians are trapped between escalating settler violence in the occupied West Bank and fear-based Hamas rule in the Gaza Strip, investigators appointed by the UN Human Rights Council said on Tuesday in a new report. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 9, 2026
item.description: Israel puts Palestinian doctor in solitary confinement after 17 months held without charge. Dr Hussam Abu Safiya now in cell barely big enough to sit in, says son, after UN experts demanded his release in March. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 8, 2026
item.description: Israel kills 14 people in attacks across Gaza. Israel killed at least 14 people in Gaza on Sunday in strikes across Khan Younis, Gaza City, and Deir el-Balah. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 7, 2026
item.description: 'What ceasefire?' Palestinians inspect destruction after Israeli strike. Palestinians inspect the aftermath of an Israeli strike in Khan Younis. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 6, 2026
item.description: Italy appeals for release of hunger-striking Flotilla activists. Italy urges Libya to free two detained pro-Palestinian activists as a Gaza aid convoy hunger strike enters its fifth day. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 5, 2026
item.description: Israel Supreme Court strikes down ban on Red Cross prison visits. Following the court's overturning of the ban, the ICRC said it is 'ready to resume' its work in visiting Palestinian prisoners in held in Israeli detention. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 4, 2026
item.description: Gaza's public servants systematically targeted in Israeli strikes. Months since Gaza's nominal ceasefire began, Palestinians continue to be killed and maimed in drone and airstrikes, including the enclave's police force which is crucial to peace and reconstruction efforts, the UN human rights office (OHCHR) said on Wednesday. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 3, 2026
item.description: Zak Khan on Israeli detention after Gaza aid mission. The New Arab Meets: Zak Khan to speak more on the Gaza flotilla, his abuse in Israeli detention, and running as a Green Party candidate in the UK. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 2, 2026
item.description: 3 Gazans killed by Israeli fire in latest ceasefire violations. Israeli army continues its daily violations of ceasefire in Palestinian enclave. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 1, 2026
item.description: Palestinian killed in Israeli drone strike in Gaza despite ceasefire. Israel has killed 932, injured 2,859 in Gaza since ceasefire, according to local authorities. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: May 31, 2026
item.description: Israeli forces kill Palestinian who allegedly carried out car-ramming attack in occupied West Bank. Suspected attacker shot dead at scene, Israeli media reports. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.
